assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's single curated item, reviewed-dedicated-analysis: the canonical V2 character reconstruction model MHA_SP2_YAOYOROZU_MOMO_CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MODEL.md at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the Japanese main manga V01-V42 with the source-labeled Ultra Archive, Ultra Analysis and Ultra Age claims its YM-SUP-01 to YM-SUP-03 sections admit. The MHA character modeling schema was consulted for method only; the readiness index, supplemental reconciliation ledger and audit and the deep readings are not curated evidence on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them. The model's strong label and its retrospective holdout probe are inputs, not conclusions. No original manga page, anime adaptation, V1 material or other character's model is included, and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Yaoyorozu from the V02:p069-070 and p174-179 task-fidelity critique and crisis coordination, through the V07:p130-132 first-place ranking and study invitation, the V08:p012-045 failure-conditioned deference and restored planning in the exam, the V10:p060 and p082 and V13:p031 tracker, restraint and treatment support, the V21:p183-193 and V22:p019 joint-training loss to Kendo, the V29:p040-067 and p128-132 delegated emergency sedation command and V30:p125-129 delayed efficacy, and the V35:p111-126 and V36:p121-151 sustained material production, to the V42:p133 later counseling activity. Kept as separable states: early analytic confidence, failure-conditioned excessive deference, restored planning authority, independent emergency command, and sustained infrastructure and adult civic work; the V30 efficacy is not available to the V29 actor and is excluded from the YM-V01 freeze. No atom covers V01, V03-V06, V09, V11-V12, V14-V20, V23-V28, V31-V34 or V37-V41.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model states a priority hierarchy (do the task properly, make knowledge useful, meet earned trust, support others' competent action), an ideal of a capable responsible planner and a feared self whose judgment fails those who depend on her, with confidence gating access to competence rather than creating it, grounded in located atoms YM01-YM06; the probe YM-V01 rates motive supported. Not B: one artifact, one retrospective nonblind probe, and the model names repeated independent and private decisions as the remaining specialist gap. Not D: the model is operational, with state-dependent policy.

Five located states are distinguished (early analytic confidence YM01-YM02, failure-conditioned deference YM03, restored planning authority YM03-YM05, independent emergency command YM06, infrastructure and adult civic work YM07 and YM-SUP-02); the model REVISEs fragile incompetence after defeat and says development is willingness to act under uncertainty, not permanent maximal confidence. Not B: long intervals are unsampled and the adult state rests on one page plus supplements. Not D: transitions are located with their knowledge differences.

The model identifies formal 私 and ですわ carrying precise evaluation, questions, explanation and encouragement, directive procedural syntax under restored command that keeps her politeness, and hesitation and deference under self-doubt; it warns against rendering formality as coldness or class disdain, and the probe rates speech/register supported. Not C: no located lines are quoted and adult private register is sparsely sampled. Not E: a recurrent register with state-conditioned variants is identified and tested on one axis. The discovery row does not enroll SPEECH.

One located ordinary window shows her eagerly offering tutoring and hosting classmates after ranking first (YM02, V07:p130-132 and the ensuing study invitation); YM-SUP-01 adds, as editorial summary, pleasure at being relied on, music learning from Jiro and surprise at a hotpot's open rules. Not C: one enacted window, with the rest editorial. Not E: the window is located and the model draws a bounded policy from it.

A five-row partner table gives conditional deltas for Todoroki, classmates she teaches, Kendo, Midnight and Majestic, and Jiro and infrastructure teams, located in YM03-YM07: Todoroki's specific prior trust restores her judgment (YM03), Kendo's respect becomes a demand for present competence (YM05), adult delegation gives real discretion without removing uncertainty (YM06). The probe rates relationship handling supported. Not B: family and adult private relations are absent. Not D: several partners have located, conditioned deltas.

Located inner-state windows are the post-failure deference and its repair with relief and tears after the exam (YM03) and the distress at apparent failure against Machia (YM06), framed by the feared-self account. C was considered and rejected: interior is inferred from conduct and speech, regulation is described in general terms, and private interior is sparsely sampled. Not E: several located windows bear on self-evaluation.

The decision policy is explicit: establish the actual task, identify constraints, create a feasible tool or sequence, assign complementary roles and reassess; under confidence collapse she may defer prematurely, and under restored standing or delegated responsibility she commits before certainty (YM03, YM05, YM06). The probe rates action supported. Not B: one probe and a sample of school, training and crisis conflict; private conflict is unsampled. Not D: the policy is explicit, repeated and located.

Located choices weigh competing considerations: the V29 emergency decision after Midnight names a legal constraint and fallback and delegates judgment (YM06), joining the rescue party as a restraint on escalation (YM04), and judging a training result by scenario fidelity rather than winner identity (YM01). The model refuses to read V29 as a belief that useful outcomes excuse any means. Not B: one high-stakes decision, with reasoning largely inferred from choices. Not D: located choices with named competing considerations. The discovery row does not enroll ETHICS.
The model analyzes no humor or play; the hotpot surprise in YM-SUP-01 is an editorial gag summary, not her enacted play. This gap says nothing about the character.

The project's analytical corpus is complete for V01-V42 and the admitted supplements; seven atoms span V02-V42 with page locators, and the V13:p105 score was checked in Japanese. Long intervals are unsampled, the adult state is one page, and the supplements are editorial summaries, profile facts, design notes and a gag.

Affirmative limits are located: the model REJECTs infinite-resource Creation and scoreboard-only evaluation (YM05-YM07), REVISEs fragile incompetence after defeat (YM03), states that the V29 actor did not know her plan had worked (YM06), records unfamiliar ordinary conventions (YM-SUP-01), and records the 94 versus 95 score discrepancy without manufacturing an explanation (YM-SUP-03). Not B: limits rest on few windows in one artifact.

Atoms are page-located with the V31 page convention stated, the frozen probe keeps V30 efficacy out of the V29 actor's knowledge, and the model requires dating knowledge and tracking stable disposition apart from temporary shaken confidence. Not B: long intervals are unsampled and in-world dates are not given.

scenario_readiness.note: The model quotes no located lines and states that generated dialogue would be an illustrative prediction, never an attributed quotation; register markers are named but adult private register is sparsely sampled. Lines beyond the described register would be fluent invention. This bounds the evidence set, not Yaoyorozu's actual speech.

conditions: Chronology is one named state, stated explicitly: early analytic confidence, failure-conditioned deference, restored planning authority, independent emergency command, or infrastructure and adult civic work; later outcomes and adult arrangements are not given to earlier states.
The confidence and authority state is specified: a recent personal failure or a trusted peer's competing judgment raises hesitation, while urgency and explicit delegated authority raise commitment.

The interlocutor is Todoroki, a classmate she teaches, Kendo, an adult authority such as Midnight or Majestic, Jiro, or an infrastructure team, handled as the partner table gives; no invented family conflict or private adult relationship.

Creation is bounded by time, mass, materials knowledge, delivery and others' execution; the correct engineering answer is not predicted without technical evidence, no quoted dialogue is produced as canon and no readiness is inherited from the strong label.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named state: early analytic confidence, post-failure deference, restored planning authority, emergency command or infrastructure and adult civic work, stated explicitly.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Todoroki, classmates, Kendo, Midnight or Majestic, Jiro or infrastructure teams, in the relation the partner table gives for that state.
setting_constraints: School, training, crisis operation or infrastructure support
Creation resource, knowledge and delivery limits respected
No family-conflict, adult private or romantic setting

scenario_readiness.note: The model's stated hypothetical (late-school Momo with a damaged support system and incomplete specifications: ask the crucial constraint, make a workable bounded replacement and coordinate a test or fallback, medium-high confidence) and the probe's supported delegated-command result support narrow novel scenes. The probe is retrospective and nonblind, and emotional trajectory was supported only conditionally.

conditions: The setting is a school-era study or teaching invitation among classmates, or reception of a classmate's unfamiliar interest, with the state named.
Output keeps enthusiastic structured help without contempt for less-resourced peers, and allows that unfamiliar ordinary conventions may need explaining to her.
Family life, adult private life and leisure outside the cited windows are not predicted.
scenario_readiness.note: Narrowly supported by one located window (YM02) and the editorial summaries in YM-SUP-01; the model's current-use section states that invitations to teach can evoke enthusiastic support and unfamiliar conventions can still require explanation.

conditions: The dilemma is a school or hero-operation decision under uncertainty, with legal or procedural constraints and responsibility to a team, and with whether authority has been delegated stated.
Output weighs task fidelity, stated constraints and teammates' welfare, and does not convert a crisis authorization into a belief that outcomes excuse any means.
Private, family and adult institutional dilemmas are not predicted.
scenario_readiness.note: Located choices (YM06 delegated emergency decision under named legal risk, YM04 restraint on escalation, YM01 fidelity over winner identity) support bounded dilemmas only.
The evidence set establishes neither romantic conduct nor its absence; the model records adult private intimacy as sparsely sampled. That limits inference; it says nothing about the character.

conditions: The setting is a training exercise, a supervised or delegated hero operation, or infrastructure and material support, with the state stated.
Output preserves planning by constraints, complementary role assignment, accountability without guaranteed success and dependence on others to transport, protect or use what she makes.
Adult research and international hero work are profile facts only; no laboratory management style or adult casework is predicted.
scenario_readiness.note: Professional conduct is located in the exam and joint training (YM03, YM05), the delegated sedation command (YM06) and sustained production (YM07); YM-SUP-02 adds adult research as a profile fact.

known_limits.statement: Creation consumes bodily resources and requires knowledge of what is made; time, mass, materials understanding, delivery and exhausted teammates constrain it, and infinite-resource Creation is REJECTed (YM06-YM07).
After failure she can defer prematurely despite a viable alternative; specific trust restores access to judgment she already had (YM03).
The V29 actor does not know her sedation plan has worked; V30 efficacy is not imported into her earlier knowledge (YM06).
Useful foresight and victory are different outcomes; she loses 4-0 while her plan stays causally active (YM05).
Her formal register carries evaluation, explanation and encouragement and is not to be rendered as coldness or class disdain (YM02 and the register analysis).
The V29 decision is a specific delegated crisis authorization, not a belief that useful outcomes excuse any means (YM06).
Knowledgeable teaching does not imply familiarity with every social setting; she is surprised by an ordinary hotpot's open rules (YM-SUP-01).

The guide's editorial licensing score of 95 conflicts with the reproduced panel and checked Japanese V13:p105 value of 94; the narrative value is 94 and the discrepancy is not explained or turned into a behavioral tier (YM-SUP-03).
Supplement profile facts, editorial summaries, design notes and the gag (YM-SUP-01 to YM-SUP-03) constrain reconstruction without becoming enacted manga observations.

The single formal probe YM-V01 is a retrospective chronological evidence holdout by an analyst who had read later manga, not a blind experiment; the exact drug, quantity and delivery success were not derivable.

The model marks private adult breadth OPEN and names repeated independent and private decisions and family conflict as unsampled; the evidence set cannot say how she behaves there. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
No atom covers V01, V03-V06, V09, V11-V12, V14-V20, V23-V28, V31-V34 or V37-V41, so behavior over those intervals is not established by this evidence set.

The deep readings, readiness index, supplemental reconciliation ledger and audit linked from the model are not curated evidence on this subject, so their warrants were not independently rechecked here. Anime performance and any supplement material beyond what the model cites lie outside this evidence set.
